name: Vercel AI Gateway
label: Vercel AI Gateway
description: Official Vercel AI Gateway OpenAI Chat Completions API (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation=chat posts to https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/chat/completions. Routes to third-party models — customer accepts Vercel AI Product Terms plus each upstream provider ToS. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key (AI Gateway key) sent as Authorization Bearer. File/image/PDF use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks-and-apis/openai-chat-completions. Terms: https://vercel.com/legal/ai-product-terms. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, stream?, model?, file?}. Image/PDF use type file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for operation=chat. List of {role, content}. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional OpenAI-style tools for chat. Omit or [] sends no tools.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for Chat Completions image/PDF attachments. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed gateway JSON (OpenAI chat completion shape; model id may differ from request after routing).

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Vercel AI Gateway API key (dashboard AI Gateway → API Keys). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_key is required'. OIDC is for apps deployed on Vercel — not this node.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Gateway model id with provider prefix. Curated options only — the catalog is 300+ models (GET https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models or https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models). Examples: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, openai/gpt-5.6-sol. Also send on llm_input so OfficialApiNode includes it in the JSON body. Docs: https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/models-and-providers .

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Vercel AI Gateway requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
